name: Please Be Quiet Brisbane 2021
information:
![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png)

Please note, this competition includes only blindfolded events. If you are interested in non-blindfolded events we recommend signing up to the [Speedcubing Australia mailing list](https://speedcubing.org.au/subscribe/) to be notified as new competitions are announced.

Competitors are strongly encouraged to bring a guest who is familiar with the process of judging blindfolded solving.

Additionally, 4x4x4 and 5x5x5 Blindfolded are strictly limited to 20 competitors due to space restrictions. This will be allocated on a first-come-first serve basis in order of payment.

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
